# Load

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(here)
library(mgcv)
library(edgeR)
library(limma)
library(endest)
library(splines)
```

```{r}
GSE234354_counts <- readRDS(here("data/GSE234354_counts.rds"))
GSE234354_gene_annotations <- readRDS(here("data/GSE234354_gene_annotations.rds"))
phenotype <- readRDS(here("data/methyl_phenotype_with_cell_props.rds"))
```


-----

# Normalise counts

For visualisation purposes, remove batch effect

```{r}
rwh_phenotype <- phenotype %>% filter(! is.na(sample_id))
rwh_phenotype <- rwh_phenotype %>% filter(! is.na(ever_pregnant))
dim(rwh_phenotype)
```

```{r}
mean(rwh_phenotype$age)
table(rwh_phenotype$ever_pregnant)
```

```{r}
table(rwh_phenotype$disease_state)
```

```{r}
y <- DGEList(GSE234354_counts[GSE234354_gene_annotations$ensembl_id,rwh_phenotype$sample_id])
y <- calcNormFactors(y)
nc <- cpm(y, log=TRUE)
```

```{r}
covariates <- model.matrix(~ rna_batch, data=rwh_phenotype)
nc_bc <- limma::removeBatchEffect(nc, covariates=covariates[,-1])

# # Functionally the same as using the batch argument, but intercept for each 
# # gene is slightly different
# nc_bc <- limma::removeBatchEffect(nc, batch=rwh_phenotype$rna_batch)
```

-----

# Plot cell lineages over time

```{r}
plot_lineage_prop <- function(lineage_name) {
  g <- ggplot(rwh_phenotype, aes(x=time, y=.data[[lineage_name]])) +
    geom_point() +
    theme_bw()
  return(g)
}
```

```{r results="asis"}
cell_types <- rwh_phenotype %>% select(starts_with("cl")) %>% colnames()
for (i in 1:length(cell_types)) {
  cat(sprintf("\n### %s\n\n", cell_types[i]))
  g <- plot_lineage_prop(cell_types[i]) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 100, 10)) +
    labs(title=str_remove(cell_types[i], "^cl_"))
  print(g)
  cat("\n")
}
```


-----

# Cell prop vs age

```{r}
plot_lineage_prop_age <- function(lineage_name) {
  g <- ggplot(rwh_phenotype, aes(x=time, y=.data[[lineage_name]], color=age)) +
    geom_point() +
    theme_bw() +
    scale_colour_gradientn(colors=hcl.colors(20))
  return(g)
}
```

```{r}
dat <- rwh_phenotype %>%
  mutate(age_scaled=scale(age)[,1]) %>%
  mutate(cycle=case_when(
    time < 9 | time > 99 ~ "men",
    time < 59 ~ "pro",
    TRUE ~ "sec"
  ))
```

## Across cycle

```{r results='markup'}
cell_types <- rwh_phenotype %>% select(starts_with("cl")) %>% colnames()
for (ct in cell_types) {
  print(ct)
  X <- cSplineDes(dat$time, knots=seq(0, 100, length=10))[,-9]
  lm_res <- lm(as.formula(paste0(ct, " ~ age + X")), data=dat)
  print(summary(lm_res))
  g <- plot_lineage_prop_age(ct) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 100, 10)) +
    labs(title=str_remove(ct, "^ct"))
  print(g)
}
```

## Within cycle stages

```{r results='markup'}
for (ct in cell_types) {
  print(ct)
  X <- cSplineDes(dat$time, knots=seq(0, 100, length=10))[,-9]
  lm_res <- lm(as.formula(paste0(ct, " ~ age_scaled:cycle + cycle + X")), data=dat)
  print(summary(lm_res))
  g <- plot_lineage_prop_age(ct) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 100, 10)) +
    labs(title=str_remove(ct, "^ct")) +
    geom_vline(xintercept=8, linetype="dashed", color="red") +
    geom_vline(xintercept=58, linetype="dashed", color="red")
  print(g)
}
```

# Age groups

```{r}
table(dat$cycle)
```


```{r}
dat_sec <- dat %>%
  filter(cycle == "sec") %>%
  mutate(age_group=ifelse(age < 35, "young", "old"))
table(dat_sec$age)
table(dat_sec$age_group)
X <- ns(dat_sec$time, 5)
summary(lm(cl_endothelial ~ X + age_group, dat_sec))
```
